title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Defaults and tooling for cost-optimization: sensible batching/caching defaults, quantization profile rollout, and unit-economics tooling to surface savings estimates for customers.
description: Context: We want stronger out-of-the-box cost savings for new and existing deployments by combining three complementary pieces: (1) autotuned batching and KV-cache defaults that match typical request shape distributions, (2) model quantization profile metadata and a light rollout path for safe switching, and (3) unit-economics tooling surfaced in the Console and CLI so customers can see estimated savings before rollout. This PR wires those changes end-to-end.
commits: feat(autotune): add workload analyzer and default batching heuristics (ENG-4211)
feat(cache): enable adaptive KV-cache sizing based on seqlen percentiles
feat(quant): add quantization profile metadata and compatibility checker
chore(ui): surface unit-econ estimator in model rollout modal
test: add integration tests for batching + cache interactions
docs: document default heuristics and safety checks for quant rollout

Priya Shah: Responded — added deterministic fallback in batching_controller and integration test that verifies p50/p95 under 99th percentile load.
Marisol Ortega: Asked for clearer UX copy in rollout modal and explicit audit log entry when quant profile changes are applied.
Priya Shah: Updated modal copy and added audit-log emit in model-registry code path.

Migration: default_profiles.yaml changes are additive; no DB migrations required
